extracted.name: Cranberry Orange Sauce
extracted.description: This homemade cranberry orange sauce is quick and easy to make with just 4 simple ingredients: fresh cranberries, brown sugar, orange juice and cinnamon.
instruction_lines: Mix cranberries, brown sugar, orange juice, orange zest, and cinnamon stick together in a saucepan; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer until cranberries pop and sauce is thickened, about 15 minutes.
For best results, transfer cranberry sauce to a bowl and refrigerate until chilled, at least 1 hour.
Remove cinnamon stick from sauce and serve at room temperature.
